description: Network-based agent simulation of social adoption dynamics driven by peer influence, intrinsic attitudes, costs, and a time-varying policy incentive. Uses small-world contact network with daily influence and adoption decisions.

modules.name: ContactNetwork
modules.description: Generates and updates the social contact network and samples daily contacts.

notes: Edge churn introduces temporal variation in contacts.
Poisson sampling produces daily variability in interactions.

modules.name: SocialInfluence
modules.description: Updates opinions using DeGroot-style averaging with intrinsic anchoring and noise; computes peer pressure.

notes: peer_pressure is fraction of adopted neighbors.

modules.name: PolicyScheduler
modules.description: Generates a time-varying policy incentive and maps to agent-level effective pressure via compliance.

notes: Linear ramp from start_day to full incentive.
Compliance scales the policy at the agent level.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Applies a soft-threshold utility model to update adoption states.

notes: Soft decision via logistic; habit_persistence locks-in adoption.
Drop-out disabled for stability; can be enabled if needed.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables across the population.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adopt_rate = mean(adopted_new_i over i)
new_adopts = sum(new_adopt_i over i)
mean_contacts = mean(contacts_today_counts[i] over i)
pol_inc = signal.policy_incentive_global
if smoothing_window_days > 1:
  apply moving average to each series over last smoothing_window_days
emit observable.adoption_rate_daily = adopt_rate
emit observable.new_adoptions_daily = new_adopts
emit observable.mean_contacts_daily = mean_contacts
emit observable.policy_incentive_daily = pol_inc
notes: Optionally smooths observables for robust calibration.

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Generates a small-world network with mean_degree and rewiring_prob.
algorithms.BarabasiAlbert: Generates a scale-free network with preferential attachment parameter m ≈ mean_degree/2.
algorithms.DeGrootOpinionUpdate: Blends prior opinion with neighbor mean under stubbornness and adds Gaussian noise.
algorithms.LogisticAdoptionDecision: Computes adoption probability via a logistic transform of utility and samples Bernoulli.
algorithms.EdgeChurn: Iteratively rewires edges with small probability to random nodes, preserving degree sequence.
algorithms.PoissonContactSampling: Daily contacts drawn from Poisson(lambda = contact_rate_scale * degree).
algorithms.MovingAverageSmoothing: Applies centered or trailing moving average over observables for noise reduction.
